definitions.explanation: passages or sections copied out from a larger text, selecting only the important or relevant parts

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}き{書|が}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I copied out the important parts from the book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議事録|ぎじろく}→議事録：07482_gijiroku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{要点|ようてん}→要点：01668_youten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}き{書|が}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled an extract of key points from the meeting minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抜|ぬ}き{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}して→残す：01975_nokosu⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{復習|ふくしゅう}→復習：01718_fukushuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役立|やくだ}つ→役立つ：03168_yakudatsu⟧。
examples.english: Keeping excerpts from papers in a notebook is useful for review.

notes:
Refers to the act of selecting and copying out important passages from a text, or the resulting collection of excerpts. A useful study and research technique.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抜|ぬ}き{書|が}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make an extract, to copy out selected parts
- {抜|ぬ}き{書|が}き⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧: notebook of excerpts
- ⟦{要点|ようてん}→要点：01668_youten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抜|ぬ}き{書|が}き: extract of key points

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧ (pulling out, selecting) and {書|が}き (writing). Literally, writing by pulling out selected parts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧: quotation, citation — a formal attribution of someone else's words, with the source specified
- ⟦{抜粋|ばっすい}→抜粋：15277_bassui⟧: excerpt, extract — more formal, often used for officially selected portions of documents
- ⟦{要約|ようやく}→要約：14128_youyaku⟧: summary — condenses the content into fewer words rather than copying verbatim
